items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free style cleanser with no active ingredients suits a young shopper's first face-washing routine.

response.routine_note: Wash your face with a small amount of LL-101 and lukewarm water once or twice a day, then pat dry; that is all a young skin routine needs. Skip strong actives and exfoliants at this age, and if you have any worries about your skin, ask a parent or carer to check in with a doctor or dermatologist.
